newsitem.title: JAPAN: TSE says may check Sega, Bandai after merger news.
newsitem.headline: TSE says may check Sega, Bandai after merger news.

text.p: The Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) is likely to conduct a routine investigation of Sega Enterprises Ltd and Bandai Co Ltd after the two firms cancelled their merger plans on Tuesday, a TSE spokesman said on Wednesday.

"We do not comment on individual shares," the spokesman said. "However, whenever there is an event that could affect share prices, it is standard procedure for the bourse to conduct an investigation."

If a problem were to be found in the course of an investigation concerning the disclosure of information, the bourse would ask firms involved to submit a report on how their disclosure methods could be improved.
"The request for a report is also standard procedure," the spokesman added.

On Tuesday, both companies' shares fell, with Sega sliding 20 yen to close at 3,700 yen and Bandai dropping 30 yen to end at 2,760 yen before the news of the cancellation was announced late in the evening, well after the market had closed.
By 0121 GMT on Wednesday, shares of Sega had climbed 60 yen to 3,760 while those of Bandai had fallen 160 yen to 2,600.
